repair.explanation: A complete first-sentence metric prefix with later source text ends in a required continuation space. Original evidence remains one item; the existing second minutes attempt must continue rather than finish the list as the entire source.

confirmed: New multi-sentence automatic caption and translation-off minutes preserve character error rate, word error rate and local cache fact without sentence error rate.
The latency/report requirement control retains transcription latency and cannot-only-report-success negation.
A metric-only closed list ends without inventing a second sentence.
Explicit cases use the original second attempt, source_predicates=1 and source_slots=1; automatic minutes can reuse validated captions.
limits: Continuation requires substantive suffix text; it is not a general semantic proof that every later clause is conserved.
Type presence guards do not bind metric values, disambiguate every acronym or establish general negation/alternative handling.
English repeated conjunctions and wider semantic quality remain open.
